notes: Phase 7 (DEC-227, the human's answers 3 and 5, 2026-10-01): a v2 story's episode is 6-10 beat shots of 5-12 s, one seedance clip each (2-12 s sold, DEC-208), the hook the one 3-6 s exception; window 55-75 s, tightening above 72 s (the schema needs tighten_above_s below the window's end). One shot per scene, two only when a scene runs past max_shot_s; a body slot tops out at 11 s so its hold (hold_extension_max_s, never past the slot) keeps a scene under 12 s. DEC-252 (the human, 2026-10-03: 'boring, no rhythm'): a body scene with two lines or two characters and at least 2 x min_shot_s is two beat shots by default (the recap, hook and cliffhanger keep one unless past max_shot_s), so an episode is 6-18 shots: 7 body scenes x 2 plus recap, hook and a cliffhanger past Veo's 8 s. A storyboard planned before keeps its shots (only a scene planned again takes the new count). Plan 28 stage A2 (DEC-305): re-slotted to the 5-10 s shot window of a native-speech clip (min_shot_s 5; recap 5-6 s, hook 5-8 s, body 10-16 s, cliffhanger 6-10 s: every slot holds one clip of every link, a body scene two; max_shot_s stays 12, the TTS beat shot's cap on seedance -- a native clip is held to 5-10 s by its links' lengths) so a native episode always fits its window: on Veo or an upload (6/8 s), in French, a body scene plans 8 + 6 s, so 6 + 4 x 14 + 8 = 70 s on episode 1 (the hook 6 s, 4 body scenes, 6 scenes) and, with the recap, 6 + 6 + 3 x 14 + 8 = 62 s (scenes [5, 6] keeps episode 2 at 3 body scenes; a 4th would make it 76 s); the end card adds 0.6 s when the cliffhanger cuts to black. Where a plan still runs past 75 s (an English line pays more words, a 10 s link fills more, the narrator speaks beside a character), the Script step holds it inside (timing.fit_episode_plans).
